Unit 2 · Adventure

Landscapes

Solutions A2 · 2A · 40 min

Where would you like to be right now?

4 min · Choose a photo and say why

4 мин, T–S. Соня выбирает фото и отвечает по рамке. Затем вопрос-повторение Past Simple. Если она отвечает Last summer I go…, покажите на рамку и попросите исправиться самой: go → ?
  • Where would you like to be right now? Why?
  • Where did you go last summer? What was it like?
Say it like this
  • I'd like to be in the Urals / at Lake Baikal / in Iceland because it looks beautiful / quiet / cold / magical.
  • Last summer I went to … It was amazing / boring / hot.

Landscape: features

7 min · Look, guess the word, then click to check

7 мин. Сначала Соня называет то, что знает (по Gateway многое должно быть знакомо), затем открывает карточки. Произношение: valley /ˈvæli/, volcano /vɒlˈkeɪnəʊ/, shore /ʃɔː/.
CCQs: stream vs river — Which is small? (stream) · hill vs mountain — Which is lower? (hill) · lake vs ocean — Which is bigger? Is a lake salty? (ocean; no) · valley — Is it between mountains or on top? (between) · cliff — Is it high and steep? Is it often next to the sea? (yes, yes) · shore — Is it where the land meets the water? (yes)

Quick check: what is it?

Landscape: adjectives

6 min · Three pairs of opposites, then four more words

6 мин. Сначала пары противоположностей, затем упражнение.
CCQs: deep — Can you stand in the water? (No) · shallow — Can you see the bottom? (Yes) · steep — Is it easy to walk up? (No) · narrow — Can a big boat go there? (No) · icy — Is it hot or cold? (cold)
Ловушка: tall — для гор и деревьев, high мы пока не берём. low hill, но не low tree в этом уроке.
tallvslow
widevsnarrow
deepvsshallow

Choose the best word

    There is or there are?

    8 min · Read the rule, describe the photo

    8 мин. Правило Соня знает по Gateway, поэтому без долгого объяснения: CCQ → упражнение → описание леса.
    CCQs: There are a river — right or wrong? Why? (wrong, one river → There's) · There's some snow — Can we count snow? (No → There's) · There aren't any people — Are there people? (No)
    Ответы: 1 There's · 2 There are · 3 There's · 4 There's · 5 There are · 6 There aren't · 7 There isn't
    Hawkins: если Соня не помнит сериал, просто «a dark forest at night». Повторяем чувства из Unit 1: frightened, anxious, nervous.
    There's … / There isn't …
    one thing or uncountable: There's a river. There's some snow. There isn't a car.
    There are … / There aren't any …
    two or more: There are tall trees. There aren't any people.

    Describe the photo

      Imagine: the forest in Hawkins at night
      The kids from Stranger Things are in the forest. What is there? How do they feel?
      There's a dark forest. There are tall trees. There isn't any light. They feel frightened / anxious because…

      Guess the place

      5 min · Choose a photo in secret. Describe it. Your teacher guesses.

      5 мин. Первый раунд описываете вы (модель), Соня угадывает. Потом Соня. В режиме учителя клик по фото отмечает «secret» — Соне его выключите или выбирайте в уме. Требуйте минимум 3 предложения с There's / There are.
      Say it like this
      • There's a big / steep / dark …
      • There are some … / a lot of …
      • There isn't a … / There aren't any …
      • It's very hot / cold / quiet there.
      • I think it's photo number …!

      My trip last summer

      7 min · Choose a photo. Imagine it was YOUR trip. Tell the story in the past.

      7 мин, продуктивная часть. Соня выбирает фото и рассказывает 6–8 предложений по таблице. Главное — прошедшее время: при I go / There is показывайте на чёрную плашку. Повторение Unit 1: чувства (-ed о себе) и get (got to, got tired). Записывайте ошибки для обратной связи.
      Now: There is / There are
      There's a lake. There are tents.
      Last summer: There was / There were
      There was a lake. There were tents.
      Last summer = past!
      Last summer I go → went · I am → was · There is → was · I feel → felt · We get → got
      PartSay it like this
      Where and whenLast summer I went to the mountains / a lake with my family / friends.
      What was thereThere was a tall mountain / an icy stream. There were a lot of trees / tents.
      What we didWe walked a lot. We rode horses. We slept in a tent. We sat by the campfire.
      getWe got to the lake at five. I got very tired / cold.
      FeelingsI felt excited / relaxed / a bit frightened because … It was an amazing / tiring day.

      Verbs you need

      go → wentbe → was / weresee → sawride → rodeswim → swamsleep → sleptsit → sateat → atetake → took (photos)get → gotfeel → feltwalk → walkedclimb → climbed

      Homework: a postcard

      20 min · Write 60–80 words to a friend from one place in this lesson

      3 мин в конце урока. 2–3 ошибки из её рассказа на экран, исправляет сама. Объясните ДЗ: в открытке два времени — «сейчас» (There is / are) и «вчера» (Past Simple). Можно добавить Wordwall «Match up» на 15 слов урока.

      Dear …,

      0 words
      Plan
      • Now: I'm in … It's beautiful here. There's a … There are …
      • Yesterday: I went … / We climbed … / There was …
      • Feelings: I felt … because …
      • End: Wish you were here! See you soon, …
